#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <regex>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::getline(std::cin, s);

    int res = 0;
    if (s.length() > 1) {
        std::regex pattern("(.)\\1*");
        std::sregex_iterator it(s.begin(), s.end(), pattern);
        std::sregex_iterator end;
        while (it != end) {
            if ((it->str().length() & 1) == 0) {
                ++res;
            }
            ++it;
        }
    }
    std::cout << res << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
